database_schema.summary: Platform for matching needs (Cần/Có), managing profiles, bots, referrals and intent extraction.
database_schema.relationships_explained: 1 User has 1 Profile and 1 UserStat. System supports Role-Based Access (User has role: USER, MODERATOR, ADMIN).

api_endpoints.explained: Secured admin endpoints for member stats and operations. Role-protected.
Bot creation, mutation and listing. Mutating actions require ADMIN role.
Bot orchestrator controls (start, stop, debates). Requires ADMIN role.
Secured Chat API for handling Global Chatbot conversations with rate limiting.

business_rules: Only 'ADMIN' rank can execute destructive Bot actions or view sensitive orchestrator dashboard cards.
'MODERATOR' rank can view referral/user data but not perform Bot manipulations.

patterns: Extending NextAuth JWT and Session properties with User role by augmenting interface typings.
Generic requireRole() helper mapping roles to hierarchy integer levels (ADMIN=2, MODRATOR=1, USER=0).
gotchas: Always call useSession() from a component wrapped inside a <SessionProvider> loaded in layout.tsx as a Client Component.
conventions: Split database layers from API handlers, use middleware for broad route protections, and use targeted role checks in API endpoints for defense-in-depth.
